log.msg: Starting step 2: census of List.add/adopt/Item.adopt_slot callers passing an already-parented item, then F7 Ref-on-add, Message.hydrate Ref support, and Chat.resurface.

Census: grepped core/Item, core/List, core/Session, core/Task test files and Servex/agents for a caller that adds an already-parented Item to a different list — none found (every .add() call in those fences passes either a fresh item or a plain literal). Built F7 in List.js: add(x) of an Item another list already owns makes a Ref (same file {path} via Item.Store.address, cross-file {url, path} via x.root().store.url) instead of re-parenting; answers the Ref. Chat.js now imports Ref.js so Message.hydrate's fallback to Item.hydrate resolves {type:"Ref"} to the real class (by/at ride as data). Added Chat.resurface(message): adds a same-file Ref at the bottom, sets resurfaced:<ref id> on the original. Tests: 8 new checks in List.test.mjs (same-file and cross-file Ref, idempotent same-list re-add), 8 new checks in Chat.test.mjs (Ref member hydration, resurface). core/Item TestRunner 20/20, core/List 2/2, core/Session 3/3, Servex/agents/chat-messages.test.mjs 13/13 (had to `npm install` in worktree Servex/ — its node_modules had never been installed here). Docs: core/Item/doc/ref.md (new section), core/List/readme.md (F7 built), core/Session/Chat/readme.md (Ref + resurface in class map, Next list).
